# scamp_vm_templates (Data Source)

Retrieves list of available VM templates (OS images).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of VM templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `api_name` (String) Internal API name of the template.
- `id` (Number) ID of the VM template.
- `name` (String) Display name of the template.
- `os_family` (String) OS family: linux, windows, bsd.
- `os_type` (String) OS type: ubuntu, debian, centos, windows-server, etc.
- `version` (String) OS version.
